generation.temporary_recipe: tools/proteus_generation/2026-06-01/generate_mixed_rcl_v1_temp.py combined locked resistor V9 records, locked resistor/capacitor mixed records, and temporary inductor V6 REALIND records; MIXED_RCL_V1_TEMP_2026_06_01.zip was rejected by user Proteus testing. After donor05/V8 was accepted, generate_mixed_rcl_v2_v8_temp.py tried locked resistor V9 records, locked capacitor manual-order records, V8 donor05 sequential inductor records as a final contiguous block, one V0 power bridge, and G0 ground endpoints; the user reported all V2 files gave VGCVC.dll. V3 showed only C+L T03 and T05 worked; every case containing both resistor and inductor failed. The user supplied rlc_manual_donor, whose object chunk has free L/R/C components in L1, R1, C1 order with matching CDB but no terminals or wires. V5 T01-T04 donor controls worked, while V5 T05-T10 generated terminal-topology variants failed. V6 showed terminal C/L combinations work around a free resistor, but every terminal-attached resistor case failed. V7 partial feedback confirmed T02-T07 worked, meaning terminal R can coexist with free L/C when the resistor block is final. V8 then showed this does not solve terminal C/L plus terminal R: only the free-L/C control T01 worked, and no-power disconnected all-terminal T02 failed. V9 isolated minimal terminal R+L order/index/suffix variants; the user reported none worked. The user then supplied rl_terminal_disconnected and rl_terminal_series. V10 uses the disconnected donor's native object order: header, both inputs, L output+REALIND+wires, then R output+RESISTOR+wires. User testing confirmed V10 opened/rendered, including donor-native mutation, connected labels, translation, and V0/G0 R+L; later feedback clarified visual opening is not simulation acceptance. V11 scaled the method with one V0 bridge, the accepted capacitor block, and repeated native R/L pair blocks for 6, 21, and 15 requested mixed R/C/L topology cases, but Proteus simulation/netlist failed with duplicate part references and generated X00000001 handles because component IDs were reused per family and CDB was source-ordered. V12 writes DSN component IDs globally across C/L/R and writes ROOT.CDB tables in DSN object-emission order; user testing confirmed the single 1C+1L+1R cases worked, but multi-component cases still failed. V13 kept global IDs and object-order CDB, and tried all R/L inputs before all L/R bodies, but user feedback still reported multi-component failures. The user then supplied rcl_4x_t07_unit_donor. V14 uses that 4x donor as the repeated complete C/L/R unit schema: one V0 bridge, then C output, C input+CAPACITOR+wires, L input, R input, L $TERGROUND+REALIND+wires, and R output+RESISTOR+wires per unit. V14 also patches mixed-resistor identity/link offsets based on visible value length and includes 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x contiguous, 4x supplied-ID-gap, 6x, 7x, and 21x diagnostics pending user Proteus netlist/simulation testing.
